items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to establishing Eid-al-Adha and Eid-Al-Fitr as school holidays
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S346

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the education law, in relation to establishing
Eid-al-Adha and Eid-Al-Fitr as school holidays

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :

To establish Eid-al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr as a school holiday as a
school holiday.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :

Section 1. The education law is amended by adding a new section 3204-a
to read as follows: 3 § 3204-a. Eid-al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr as a
school holiday. The days of the Islamic lunar calendar designated to
begin on the tenth day of the month of Dhul Hijja and commonly known
as "EidUlAdha" shall be a school holiday for all public schools in a
city school district of a city having a population of one million or
more.

2. The school authorities of every public school in a city school
district of a city having a population of one million or more are
hereby authorized and directed to cause all public schools within such
district to be closed on Eid-al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr.

§ 2. Section 3604 of the education law is amended by adding a new
subdivision 7-c to read as follows: 7-c. Notwithstanding any other
provision of law, for purposes of any calculation under subdivision
seven or eight of this section, the commissioner shall disregard any
reduction resulting from observance of Eid-al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr, if
necessary, such observed holiday shall be calculated as a session day.

 JUSTIFICATION :

NYC Public School calendar recognizes various inter-faith/ religious
holidays by closing for business. Muslims celebrate two holidays in a
year and these holidays should be recognized by our public school
system. Muslims represent a growing population in NYC region and
Eid-al-Adha and Eid al-Fitr should be recognized as an approved
holidays.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2015-2016 - S4333

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect on the one hundred twentieth day after it
shall have become a law; provided that any and all rules and
regulations and any other measures necessary to implement any
provision of this act on its effective date may be promulgated and
taken, respectively, on or before such effective date.

summary: Establishes Eid-al-Adha and Eid-al-Fitr as school holidays in certain school districts.
